items.title: python-1.11.0
items.summary: The Microsoft Agent Framework 1.11.0 release introduces key features such as message injection middleware for dynamic message handling, progressive MCP disclosure for on-demand tool schema management, and a refresh interval for cached skill lists. These enhancements improve agent responsiveness, context-aware filtering, and overall performance, enabling developers to create more efficient and adaptable AI agents.

items.title: What’s New in Microsoft Foundry | June 2026
items.summary: Microsoft Foundry has announced the general availability of Claude, alongside new features including autopilot agents, expanded Toolboxes and Routines, and a private preview of the Agent Optimizer. These updates enhance the platform's capabilities, enabling developers to create more efficient and effective AI-driven applications.

items.title: dotnet-1.13.0
items.summary: The .NET 1.13.0 release introduces several enhancements, including improved shell handling for dotnet-format, added skill approval options, and per-user session isolation for Foundry Hosting. Notably, it also includes breaking changes to the FileAccess/FileMemory store API and refactors OpenAI Hosting options for better security and usability.

items.title: dotnet-1.12.0
items.summary: The .NET 1.12.0 release introduces several enhancements, including OAuth consent support for Foundry hosted-agent toolbox and a new BackgroundTaskCompletionLoopEvaluator for harness background agents. It also includes breaking changes, such as aligning Foundry.Hosting experimental flags with MAAI001 and extracting caching functionality into a new CachingAgentSkillsSource, improving overall framework stability and functionality.

items.title: Claude models generally available in Microsoft Foundry
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku families are now GA in Foundry with Azure-hosted and Anthropic-hosted deployment options, Entra ID auth, Marketplace billing (CCUs), MACC eligibility, and zero-data-retention options for regulated workloads.

items.title: python-1.10.0
items.summary: The agent-framework version 1.10.0 introduces several enhancements, including explicit emission of available resources in skill content, improved error handling for skill scripts, and the addition of a FoundryAgent conversation session helper. Key changes include breaking updates to file access approvals and the Foundry Hosted Agent V2 protocol upgrade, which enhance security and functionality for developers.

items.title: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 released
items.summary: The open-source SDK unifying Semantic Kernel and AutoGen hits 1.0 for Python and .NET — agents, typed workflows, orchestration patterns (sequential, concurrent, handoff, magentic), MCP/A2A/OpenAPI interop, and OpenTelemetry built in.

items.title: Microsoft Foundry unveiled at Ignite 2025
items.summary: Azure AI Foundry becomes Microsoft Foundry: a redesigned agent-first portal, hosted agents for any framework, Foundry IQ knowledge bases, the Foundry Control Plane for Day 2 operations, and Entra Agent ID for agent identity.

items.title: Hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service (public preview)
items.summary: Bring code-first agents built with Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, or CrewAI into Foundry as managed container-based agents — invoked via the Responses API with built-in scaling, identity, tracing, and governance.

items.title: Model Router reaches general availability
items.summary: Foundry's Model Router automatically routes each request to the best-fit model for quality vs. cost across the catalog — swap or add underlying models without changing application code.

items.title: AI Red Teaming Agent and continuous evaluations in the Control Plane
items.summary: Automated adversarial testing built on PyRIT plus agentic evaluators (intent resolution, tool-call accuracy, task adherence) now run pre-deployment and continuously against live traffic from the Foundry Control Plane.
